essence: Consuming the mantra one thousand and one times is prescribed for overcoming a fierce enemy.
After seven days of oblations, the wise one is able to dispatch the king's army.
The army should be sent forth only when made very firm and guarded by strong men.
The minister's worship while devouring causes the army to arrive.
After the army's arrival, the heroic king comes to the minister with respect.
